user.title: Put the Vent-Axia unit into pairing mode
user.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. The LED will flash blue while Bluetooth pairing mode is active. Select Submit to scan for the unit.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required; Home Assistant will complete the MEV pairing exchange automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the unit again
reauth_confirm.description: Press Mode once to wake the display. Hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required.

airflow_profile.title: Configure airflow levels
airflow_profile.description:
Current profile: **{current_profile}**

These are the unit's four commissioned **motor-speed percentages**, not measured fan RPM. Actual RPM is shown by the Fan RPM sensor and can vary with duct resistance and load. The levels must remain ordered Low < Normal < Boost < Purge.

Changing commissioned airflow can affect ventilation performance and building-compliance rates. Record the current values and change them only if you understand the required airflow for the installation.

airflow_confirm.title: Confirm airflow levels
airflow_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current profile: **{current_profile}**

New profile: **{new_profile}**

Home Assistant will update only the changed fields, in an order that keeps Low < Normal < Boost < Purge valid after every write. Each field must be returned exactly by a fresh settings read before the next field is sent. If any write or readback fails, the flow reports failure rather than claiming the complete profile was applied.

data.confirm_airflow: I understand these are commissioned motor-speed percentages and want to apply the reviewed profile

airflow_result.title: Airflow levels confirmed
airflow_result.description: The installed unit returned **{new_profile}** through fresh settings readback. Measured Fan RPM may take time to settle and can differ with duct resistance and load.

sensor_thresholds.title: Configure CO₂ and humidity thresholds
sensor_thresholds.description:
Current thresholds: **{current_thresholds}**

These values control when humidity and internal CO₂ demand can request higher ventilation. They are installer settings, not the current sensor readings. CO₂ Boost must remain below CO₂ Purge.

Writes are enabled only for the physically validated model 10 / firmware 2.03.08 / hardware 01.00 identity. Record the current values before making an installer change.

sensor_thresholds_confirm.title: Confirm CO₂ and humidity thresholds
sensor_thresholds_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current thresholds: **{current_thresholds}**

New thresholds: **{new_thresholds}**

Home Assistant will update only changed fields in an order that keeps CO₂ Boost < CO₂ Purge after every write. Each field must be returned exactly by a fresh settings read before the next field is sent. A failure can leave earlier confirmed fields applied, so reopen this flow and inspect the current values before retrying.

data.confirm_sensor_thresholds: I have recorded the current values and want to apply these thresholds

sensor_thresholds_result.title: CO₂ and humidity thresholds confirmed
sensor_thresholds_result.description: The installed unit returned **{new_thresholds}** through exact fresh settings readback. The complete threshold profile is confirmed.

calibrate_co2.title: Choose a CO₂ calibration method
calibrate_co2.description:
Calibration changes the accuracy of future CO₂ readings. The official Vent-Axia app accepts 400–2,000 ppm and defaults to 450 ppm. Leave 450 selected after the fresh-air preparation, or enter a reading from a trusted calibrated measurement device. A Home Assistant reference sensor should be used only when you know it is a trusted, recently calibrated, true CO₂ sensor.

Home Assistant has no safe factory/default calibration reset. To correct an earlier calibration, wait at least five minutes and run this flow again.

calibration_exposure.title: Prepare and enter the calibration value
calibration_exposure.description:
For the official 450 ppm default:
1. Open external windows and doors in every room from which the MEV extracts air.
2. Ventilate for at least 15 minutes.
3. Keep those rooms unoccupied and leave the openings open.
4. Leave the value at 450 ppm.

Alternatively, enter a current reading from a trusted calibrated measurement device. The accepted range is 400–2,000 ppm. After final confirmation, Home Assistant will display the MEV manual's three-minute sampling progress. Keep the conditions unchanged until that progress finishes; you do not need to see or reach the installed MEV/Multihome unit.

calibration_reference.title: Choose trusted CO₂ references
calibration_reference.description: Select one or more independent Home Assistant CO₂ sensors. Prefer one trusted sensor per extracted room. Home Assistant cannot determine whether a sensor is calibrated, accurate, or reports true CO₂ rather than estimated eCO₂. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions stable until calibration finishes.

calibration_confirm.title: Confirm CO₂ calibration
calibration_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Calibration target: **internal MEV CO₂ sensor**

Reference: **{reference_ppm} ppm**

{reference_summary}

After confirmation, Home Assistant will track the documented three-minute sampling period. If the firmware completes, this new calibration supersedes the earlier baseline. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions unchanged until its progress finishes. The physical status LED should flash magenta, but you do not need to see or reach the installed unit. An incorrect reference will make future CO₂ readings inaccurate.

data.confirm_calibration: I have completed the preparation and confirm that the reference is trustworthy

calibration_progress.title: CO₂ calibration sampling timer
calibration_progress.description: Home Assistant sent the {reference_ppm} ppm command to {device} and is tracking the MEV manual's three-minute internal-sensor sampling period. Keep every extracted room ventilated, unoccupied, and unchanged until the progress reaches 100%. At 100%, the documented sampling period has elapsed and you may close this screen with X, even if Home Assistant does not automatically advance. Closing this screen earlier does not stop a calibration command already sent.

calibration_result.title: Sampling period elapsed
calibration_result.description:
The MEV manual's three-minute sampling period has elapsed for the {reference_ppm} ppm command sent to {device}. You may now close the windows and use the rooms normally. This Home Assistant timer does not prove firmware completion because the MEV protocol exposes no calibration-status readback.

Calibration can be run again after the five-minute safety cooldown. Home Assistant has no safe calibration-reset command; repeat the prepared flow with the official 450 ppm default or a trusted measured value.

delay_overrun.title: Configure Delay On and Overrun
delay_overrun.description:
Current timers: **{current_timers}**

Delay On is a guarded prerelease validation control. The two earlier writes used packet destination 0; the recovered official-client path copies the requested boolean into the destination as well as field 7. Change Delay On by itself, keep its timer within 1–60 minutes, and leave LS inputs inactive during this storage test.

Delay time, Overrun, and Overrun time remain physically validated installer controls. Runtime electrical-input timing has not been tested because no switched-live input was connected.

delay_overrun_confirm.title: Confirm Delay On and Overrun
delay_overrun_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current timers: **{current_timers}**

New timers: **{new_timers}**

For a Delay On change, Home Assistant sends only field 7 and copies its 0/1 value into the packet destination, matching the recovered official-client path. It requires a fresh unchanged 36-byte baseline and exact packet-137 readback. Restore the original Delay On state through this same flow after the first successful change.

data.confirm_delay_overrun: I recorded the current values and want to apply this paired timer profile

delay_overrun_result.title: Delay On and Overrun confirmed
delay_overrun_result.description: The installed unit returned **{new_timers}** through exact fresh packet-137 readback. If Delay On changed, restore its original state now through the same guarded flow; runtime LS-input timing remains a separate test.

boost_minimum.title: Configure Boost minimum
boost_minimum.description:
Current value: **{current_boost_minimum}**

The recovered app names packet-136 field 4 `BoostMin`. Storage writes are validated on the exact model 10 / firmware 2.03.08 / hardware 01.00 identity, but its runtime effect and relationship to the commissioned airflow profile are not characterised. Use the recovered **0–100%** wire range cautiously and record the original value before changing it.

boost_minimum_confirm.title: Confirm Boost minimum
boost_minimum_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current value: **{current_boost_minimum}**

New value: **{new_boost_minimum}**

Home Assistant will send only field 4 and accept success only after an exact fresh packet-137 readback. This confirms storage, not the setting's runtime effect.

data.confirm_boost_minimum: I recorded the current value and understand that the runtime effect is not characterised

boost_minimum_result.title: Boost minimum confirmed
boost_minimum_result.description: The installed unit returned **{new_boost_minimum}** through exact fresh packet-137 readback. Observe fan level, RPM, and state separately; this result proves storage, not runtime behaviour.

temperature_validation.title: Configure temperature settings
temperature_validation.description:
Current profile: **{current_profile}**

Current measured temperature: **{current_temperature}**

This flow is available only while Low-temperature protection (field 16) is already Off, and it never writes field 16. Change exactly one action or threshold per submission. Home Assistant confirms the complete fresh packet-137 record before reporting success. These settings were storage-tested and restored on the exact validated identity, but changing them did not demonstrate a runtime fan-speed response.

temperature_validation_confirm.title: Confirm one temperature setting change
temperature_validation_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current profile: **{current_profile}**

Proposed profile: **{new_profile}**

Home Assistant will send exactly one packet-136 field update and accept success only after the complete fresh packet-137 record matches. Field 16 remains Off and is never written. This changes an installer setting; it does not directly command the fan.

data.confirm_temperature_validation: I reviewed the current and proposed profiles and want to apply this setting change

temperature_validation_result.title: Temperature settings confirmed
temperature_validation_result.description: The installed unit returned **{new_profile}** through exact fresh packet-137 readback. This confirms the stored profile, not that a temperature condition has triggered a fan-speed change.

low_temperature_protection_validation.title: Configure Low-temperature protection
low_temperature_protection_validation.description:
Current protection: **{current_protection}**

Current profile: **{current_profile}**

Current measured temperature: **{current_temperature}**

This guarded flow writes only packet-136 field 16 on the exact physically validated identity. Enabling protection may make the unit respond immediately to the stored temperature profile.

low_temperature_protection_validation_co.title: Confirm Low-temperature protection change
low_temperature_protection_validation_co.description:
Device: **{device}**

Current protection: **{current_protection}**

New protection: **{new_protection}**

Stored profile: **{current_profile}**

Home Assistant will send only field 16 after a fresh full-record check and will accept success only when exact packet-137 readback confirms the complete record.

data.confirm_low_temperature_protection: I recorded the current value and profile and want to perform this field-16 validation

low_temperature_protection_validation_re.title: Low-temperature protection confirmed
low_temperature_protection_validation_re.description: The installed unit returned Low-temperature protection **{new_protection}** through exact fresh packet-137 readback.
